en.io: Input is an explicit destination choice plus embedded agent assets named by the reference. Outputs are the created target directory, copied agent-definition files, overwrite reporting, and an optional verification command.
en.boundary: No file may be copied before the destination is confirmed. All referenced embedded files must be copied with their original names, and overwrites must be reported. The attached evidence does not contain the file list or assets, so their contents cannot be assessed.
dependencies: Write access to the selected project directory
scenarios: Bootstrap embedded agents for Claude Code.
Reinstall the bundle while reporting files that would be overwritten.

zh.io: 输入是明确的目标目录选择，以及参考文件列出的嵌入式代理资源。输出包括创建的目标目录、复制的代理定义文件、覆盖报告和可选验证命令。
zh.boundary: 确认目标目录前不得复制文件；必须复制参考内容列出的全部文件并保留文件名，覆盖操作必须报告。附带证据没有文件清单或资源内容，因此无法评估这些文件本身。
dependencies: assets/agents 下的嵌入式代理文件
所选项目目录的写权限
scenarios: 为 Cursor 初始化嵌入式代理。
为 Claude Code 初始化嵌入式代理。
